format: C header file (C/C++), with Lua bindings
description: This file defines bindings for loading and rendering 3D models, specifically '.obj' files, in a Lua scripting environment. It declares two external functions: loadModel and model, which interact with Lua state to load and display 3D models within a graphics application.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads a 3D model from a specified file path, supporting only '.obj' files, and returns the model to Lua.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Renders the loaded 3D model in the current rendering context.
